name: talisman

attributes.attribute: draws good fortune or the blessing of a god
wards off evil spirits and bad luck

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: A talisman is a symbolic object. People do not always keep a clear line between it and the amulet. Often the two words mean the same thing. Both name a magical object, yet their purpose differs. A talisman brings good luck to its owner. It may also bring the favor of a god. An amulet keeps away evil spirits and ill fortune.

okr.objective: Record the talisman as a magical object set against the amulet.
key_results: Explains that the words talisman and amulet often serve as synonyms
Gives the talisman the power to draw good luck or divine favor
Gives the amulet the power to ward off evil spirits
